content:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration with two participants: the organisation and external applicants -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="ORG_POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="ORG_PROCESS" />
    <bpmn:participant id="APPLICANTS_POOL" name="Applicants" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process belonging to the organisation pool -->
  <bpmn:process id="ORG_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes for actors inside the organisation -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANESET_ORG">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_FUNCTIONAL_DEPT" name="Functional Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Demand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerDemand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_HR" name="HR Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AdvertisePost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckApplications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FillPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Filled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Demand" name="Process triggered by demand" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TriggerDemand" name="Functional department requests to fill a post" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdvertisePost" name="Advertise the post" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicantsApply" name="Applicants apply" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckApplications" name="Check applications" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FillPost" name="Fill the post" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Filled" name="Post filled – contract concluded" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start_Demand" targetRef="Task_TriggerDemand" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_TriggerDemand" targetRef="Task_AdvertisePost" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_AdvertisePost" targetRef="Task_ApplicantsApply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Task_ApplicantsApply" targetRef="Task_CheckApplications" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Task_CheckApplications" targetRef="Task_FillPost" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_FillPost" targetRef="End_Filled" />

    <!-- Message flow from external Applicants pool to HR task (optional) -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M1" sourceRef="APPLICANTS_POOL" targetRef="Task_ApplicantsApply" />

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
```
